item.title: Officials capture mountain lion that's been prowling SF's Pac Heights neighborhood
item.description: "We locked eyes for over five minutes," said one woman who came face-to-face with the big cat wandering the streets of San Francisco. "I was actually really honored that the mountain lion didn't eat me and we just had this nice long gaze into each other's souls."

item.title: Man tackled to ground after spraying unknown substance on Rep. Ilhan Omar at Minneapolis town hall
item.description: A man was tackled to the ground after spraying an unknown substance on U.S. Rep. Ilhan Omar at a town hall she was hosting in Minneapolis.

item.title: NASA says plane's 'mechanical issue' results in 'gear-up landing' at Houston-area airport
item.description: In a post to social media, a NASA spokesperson said a "mechanical issue with one of NASA's WB-57s resulted in a gear-up landing." A video showed the landing, with fiery sparks visible.

item.title: Here's how much it costs to attend, stay in Bay Area for Super Bowl LX
item.description: Attending the game will not be cheap and that's not even including airfare, hotels and other travel costs. Here's what the ABC7 data team found.

item.title: Burbank Airport could be next scene of mid-air crash, airlines warn NTSB
item.description: The chair of the National Transportation Safety Board expressed concern over the possibility of a mid-air collision at Hollywood Burbank Airport.

item.title: Family pleads for help in finding hit-and-run driver who killed 17-year-old girl in Antioch
item.description: The family of 17-year-old Jeana Flores is pleading for help after she was killed by a hit-and-run-driver in Antioch last week. Police say she was found lying on the shoulder of the road with scrapes and gashes on her head and hands.

item.title: Mother arrested after video shows toddler fall out of moving SUV in Southern California
item.description: Shocking video shows the moment the child fell. As the SUV made a turn, the passenger door opened, and the 19-month-old child fell to the ground.

item.title: Berkeley residents divided over fire prevention ordinance; no wooden structures within 5 ft of home
item.description: A new fire prevention ordinance called EMBER is forcing Berkeley Hills neighbors into a tense standoff, requiring that nothing living remain within five feet of their homes. That's not just inconvenient-it's a dramatic overhaul. Here's why the pushback is growing.

item.title: Judge issues temporary order barring removal of boy, 5, and father who were detained in Minnesota
item.description: A federal judge has issued a temporary order prohibiting removal of a 5-year-old Ecuadorian boy and his father who were arrested last week in Minnesota.

item.title: 9 injured after 43-vehicle pileup in dense fog on Highway 58 in Bakersfield
item.description: A massive pileup involving more than 40 cars shut down part of Highway 58 in Bakersfield, and investigators believe fog may have been a contributing factor.
